text:
Alice Ramos: Kicking off a quickstart for getting our first marketplace listings across AWS/GCP/Azure. Goal: minimum viable offer + trial SKU live in 2 weeks. Who can triage asset gaps today? :wave:
Ben Cho: I can run a pass on the asset manifest and AMI/container bits. I need to know which SKUs we want exposed for trial.
Carla Nguyen: I'll handle legal + EULA variants. Quick Q — do we plan to reuse the same EULA doc across clouds or separate per vendor?
Alice Ramos: Prefer single base EULA and vendor-specific addenda if needed. Carla: can you draft addenda skeleton by EOD?
Carla Nguyen: Yep, will have the skeleton and a short checklist for marketing/legal signoff.
marketplace-bot: Asset manifest scan complete: 6 expected artifacts. Found: logo (svg/png) ✓, screenshots ✓, AMI IDs missing for AWS (us-east-1/us-west-2) ✖, GCP image family missing ✖, Azure offer package missing ✖. Details: https://redwood.example.com/internal/marketplace/scan/2418001234
Ben Cho: Copy. I'll upload AMIs and provide the IDs. For GCP/Azure I need build artifacts — @Devon can you publish the images?
Devon Patel: On it. I'll push GCP image family and prep Azure offer package tonight. Need publisher portal access for the Azure publisher account.
Ben Cho: I'll share a temporary role with publisher permissions - aws/gcp/azure creds in 1Password.
Alice Ramos: For packaging: use trial_sku=redwood-trial-30d, pricing tier = free-credit-first-30. Keep description aligned with marketing. Carla please approve legal text before Ben uploads manifests.
Carla Nguyen: I'll do a legal quick-pass; please ping when the manifest is in draft. Also: we need a short privacy blurb for the listing — what telemetry do we collect by default?
Ben Cho: Minimal telemetry: requestlatency_ms, model_id, token_count. No user PII. I'll paste a snippet for the privacy blurb:
Privacy: We collect anonymized inference metrics (latency, model ID, token counts) to monitor usage and billing. No customer content is stored by default.
Alice Ramos: Good. Also add a note that customers can opt into enhanced logging (S3) for debugging with explicit consent.
Devon Patel: FYI: Azure pack requires a CSV mapping for SKU -> entitlement. Example row: `redwood-trial-30d,TRIAL,30,free-credit`
Ben Cho: Thanks. I'll add that mapping to the manifest. Also noting a small template for the offer YAML:
offer:
  name: redwood-inference
  skus:
    - id: redwood-trial-30d
      title: "Redwood Inference - Trial"
      price: 0
Alice Ramos: Great. Action items: Ben = upload drafts + AMI IDs by 6pm PT, Devon = publish GCP/Azure images tonight, Carla = legal skeleton and privacy blurb by EOD. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT to validate the staging listing and run the preflight checklist. :calendar:
marketplace-bot: Preflight checklist link: https://redwood.example.com/internal/marketplace/preflight/2418001234 — current status: 3/8 checks passed.
Carla Nguyen: Noted, I'll review the privacy text once Ben posts the manifest.
Devon Patel: Dropping a note: if anyone needs access to the publisher portal, list the emails here and I'll request invites.
Ben Cho: Added alice@redwood.com, devon@redwood.com.
Alice Ramos: Thanks — I'll jump on the sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
